messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "request_refill uses rx_40871 (atorvastatin, 0 refills) instead of the confirmed lisinopril rx_40817.", "verifier": {"reason": "The current action (t0) violates the requirement that a prescription must have at least 1 refill remaining (`refills_remaining` >= 1) to request a refill. The evidence (h39) shows `refills_remaining` = 0 for atorvastatin (rx_40871). Additionally, the user's explicit confirmation (h41) was for lisinopril (rx_40817), not atorvastatin (rx_40871), violating the confirmation requirement for this action."}}
